Silver Sable hires Spider-Man and Sandman to help her bring down Neo-Nazi leader Franz Kraus who wants to buy his own state and start the Fifth Reich in America. After the adventure is concluded, Spider-Man returns home to find Mary Jane has packed her bags and is willing to move to Kansas with him. longest_story.synopsis: Sandman learns of an arms shipment that is about to be hijacked and calls in his new Avengers buddies. Spider-Man learns the same thing and joins up with them. Sandman flies off the handle when Captain America chastises him and quits.
longest_story.notes: Sandman became an Avenger in The Avengers #329 and quits this issue

longest_story.title: Man of Steal!
longest_story.characters: Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; Mary Jane Parker; Black Fox (villain); Dr. Doom (cameo)
longest_story.synopsis: The Black Fox steals the Trask Diamond and Spider-Man tracks him down just as Dr. Doom shows up.

longest_story.title: Doom Service!
longest_story.first_line: Night: A deserted Long Island resort complex...
longest_story.characters: Black Fox; Captain America [Steve Rogers] (flashback) (cameo); Doctor Doom [Victor Von Doom]; Ben Parker (supporting) (hallucination); May Parker (flashback) (cameo); Prowler [Hobie Brown] (flashback) (cameo); Sandman [Flint Marko] (flashback) (cameo); Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; Thor (flashback) (cameo); Mary Jane Watson-Parker; Andrew Carpathian (villain); Arcane Order of the Night (villain)
longest_story.synopsis: Black Fox unwittingly stole a gem that Doom's mother gave him and Doom wants it back. Spider-Man promises Doom he will track down the Black Fox and get the jewel back in 24 hours. Doctor Doom, Black Fox and Spider-Man team up against the secret order who bought the Dragon's Egg on the black market.
longest_story.keywords: Dragon's Egg (emerald); Long Island; New Jersey; Soho; Trask Diamond
